title: The model-name report guard skips ids and reads each agent's served model
why: The guard fired on the role word inside the backticked id `builders-cannot-edit-tests` (about 17:43 CST Nov 7); an Opus third try shows sonnet in the spawn record, so the report names the wrong model.
note: Fix: skip role words inside backticked ids; read each agent's served model, not the brief's. Done check: lint tests for the backticked-id case and the Opus-third-try case. Filed from lane notes-fix-large-3 ([ended:lane:-notes-fix-large-3]), 18:04 CST Nov 7, at the coordinator's ask. Built as #1705, with runner 8 with a merge-tool record for its live head (19:50 CST). #1690 is closed, replaced by #1705; #1716 and #1721 stack on it. The guard should read the role file's model when the spawn names none. Check whether the open fix covers this case.
